title: Not Quite a Pegasus
description: 'ave ya evher tried ridin' a hoss aroun' a mountain or ravine? it's 'ard sumtaahms t' keep 'em awn thuh flader surfaces an not tay-uk a dive, ah'll tell ya that much.  Fortunately, maah partner created this special stabilizer usin' thayse little canisters.  Whe-yn ya're awn a hoss an ya fuh-all a certain diestance, thuh win's will come out an slow yo-wr fuh-all ta a nahce safe glaahd.  It's a fuh-auhrly big device, kay-yun't use any carts with it, but ah imagaahn that would look straynge everhoo
